papers.title: Persistent Homology-induced Graph Ensembles for Time Series Regressions
papers.publication_status: Preprint; exact-title SSRN posted-content DOI10.2139/ssrn.5521531; no conference/journal verified
papers.takeaway: PH death-time thresholds produce distinct graph supports. Separate temporal/GCN weights per graph feed shared graph-attention fusion and output MLP. Only aggregate regression loss is printed in scope. No GNN-backbone sharing, scorer-only feedback or uniform classifier pool stated.

papers.title: Semi-Supervised Learning for Molecular Graphs via Ensemble Consensus
papers.takeaway: Independently initialized models receive own supervised loss plus stopped current-mean prediction consistency on unlabeled TRAIN inputs. Summed member losses update simultaneously. GNN+ protocol uses10% labeled data, gamma1 selected onZINC. No shared feature backbone or scorer/QK-only recipients printed.
papers.relation_to_GRAND_GraphMix: Graph consistency/shared-view targets are already established; this is a concrete graph-ensemble member-quality comparator, not discovery of graph consistency.
papers.full_label_possible_adaptation: Separately frozen consistency on TRAIN graph inputs while keeping all TRAIN labels in own supervised loss; explicitly an adaptation, no additional held molecule inputs.
papers.low_label_possible_task: Prospectively fixed labeled subset within officialTRAIN; remainingTRAINinputs unlabeled to all matched methods.
papers.data_boundary: Never move officialVALID/TEST graph-inductive molecule inputs into unlabeledTRAIN. Transductive node-input permission does not transfer to graph-inductive datasets.

mechanism_gap: Current labeled relation credit versus unlabeled output consensus are different signals. Evidence diversity and useful member competence need separate measurements; neither method guarantees repair of identical common wrong predictions.
novelty_status: Unresolved; no complete scoped collision established and no absence/priority certificate.
